nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A pocket of quieter air near the terrace doors: Voss and a ministry aide speaking like people who believe ferns don't have ears.

choices.text: Send Pim in as a conversational torpedo, then catch the aftermath.
Skip the eavesdrop — head for the study annex while the salon is loud.

faculty_interjections.text: Ferns are cover. Use the guilty ferns.
Aide's posture says east docks. Confirm.
Or go be useful elsewhere before you become a listening device.

nodes.speaker: edrin_voss
nodes.text: ...the east-dock window closes Friday if the discrepancy stays unreconciled. I want the revised schedule in my study before the toast. Quietly. Porcelain doesn't like panic.

effects.summary: Voss needs east-dock schedule revised before the toast; discrepancy unresolved.

faculty_interjections.text: Deadline: toast. Location: study. Objective just grew teeth.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The aide murmurs assent. Something about a ciphered guest addendum — names that aren't names — and then they drift apart like nothing happened except the shape of the evening.

effects.summary: Guest addendum may carry ciphered names tied to the dock discrepancy.

choices.text: Study annex. Before the toast. Before Sera.
Check on Maris first — human continuity matters.

faculty_interjections.text: You can move and still be a person. Sequence carefully.

nodes.speaker: pim_orel
nodes.text: Lord Voss! Have you met my theory about canapés as soft power? No? Wonderful — walk with me while I ruin both our reputations.

faculty_interjections.text: Pim is a wrecking ball with a guest pass. Bless him.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: In the vacuum Pim creates, the aide drops a folio edge — east-dock revision stamps, toast-timed. You catch the phrase 'guest cipher, annex' before dignity returns to the hallway.

effects.summary: Via Pim's chaos: dock revision before toast; cipher in annex.

choices.text: Annex. Quietly. Before Pim invents a second theory.

faculty_interjections.text: Debt to Pim logged. Pay it somehow that isn't betrayal.
